[h3][i]This is (hopefully) the last devlog before the game comes out.[/i][/h3]

It's about weapon upgrades for levels on the boat.


There will be 4 in total and each can be upgraded multiple times.

Fires multiple rounds in a row. At maximum level one of the shots will be enhanced.

Fires multiple projectiles. More shells are fired as you upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/be85204ebdb1da850e0cfeae27ed9ed8aeb693f7.gif[/img]

4. [b]Parrot Cage[/b]
Fires a homing mechanical parrot that flies at the nearest enemy. With upgrade, an explosion appears on contact with the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/bad1876629c3562c5e247482d7f3f66b5824efda.gif[/img]

That's all for now. 
🌴Thank you for your attention. 🌴

notes.title: Steam Fest results
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/1ec41be3ff45208d94a8f4253ac54d26b70faa0f.png[/img]

[h2]Hi all![/h2]

[h3]it's time to sum up the results of Steam Fest![/h3]

I thank Steam from the bottom of my heart for the opportunity to show my game to so many gamers. 
A huge thanks to the people who came to the streams and added the game to their wishlist.
A special thanks to the people who took the survey (which means they made it to the end) and left their feedback. 
I've read absolutely all of the feedback and suggestions and will definitely consider them.
Here are some planned changes:

- [i][b]Main character design[/b][/i]. 
   It was noticed that the character seems faded, I will work on this.
- [i][b]Balance existing locations, enemies and bosses[/b][/i].
- [i][b]All sorts of QOL additions[/b][/i]. 
   Mostly visual cues to let the player know what they are required to do.
- [i][b]Sections on the boat[/b][/i]. 
   Shorter in time, but more intense in action.

[h2][b]Thank you very much once again![/b][/h2] 

Stay tuned.

notes.title: DEVLOG #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/1ec41be3ff45208d94a8f4253ac54d26b70faa0f.png[/img]

[h2][b]Greetings![/b][/h2]

[i]Today I will tell you about the enemies and their interaction with special items.[/i]

On each island you will have a special item available for you to use. These items do not deal damage, but they can nevertheless help in battles.

One such item is a magic bow, which leaves a ghostly spirit that fires an electric arrow forward. 

It does not deal damage to enemies, but in the example below you can see that when it hits a scarab's nest, an electric discharge appears after a while and destroys all scarabs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/0219deb23dfe42648275004c12342426d272ed6c.gif[/img]

And here is another example with a spring. This lizard will roll over and be open to attack if you jump on it

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/33c10b5dbc7db0823f4e9a1257c282d4ba67d2a6.gif[/img]

And one of my favorite enemies is a big skeleton. He has quite a lot of HP and his attacks, though not the fastest, but have a large damage radius.
When fighting him in close combat, you have to be very careful.
However, if you shoot a boomerang at him and remove some of his armor, he will stop and hit the ground with his hands, throwing stones up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/6dcaabffda35f2998a2c42a668573cfad9e19e95.gif[/img]

And if you hit him with the boomerang one more time, all his armor will come off and he'll have nothing left but to run away from you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/a57ab7d2653c1828563dd83651821b2941093bcf.gif[/img]

I hope you enjoyed this devlog and learned more about special items.
Thank you for your attention!

notes.title: DEVLOG #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/489b731903f2210cdc3fe53ea5224660bfac7841.png[/img]

[h2][b]Greetings![/b][/h2]

[i]In this devlog we'd like to talk about global map. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/9e51752a914fb679d5094de7d962ff4a6dab06ce.png[/img]

There will be five islands in the game. The top left will show basic information about current progress: defeated bosses, collected keys and jade coins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/2c14efa01e02c2c49d1f5df00560c7a3d90a9b9a.gif[/img]
[i]And here's the zoom animation when selecting an island. What do you think?[/i]

As you zoom in, you can see little animations like grass rippling in the wind, snowing, or lava flowing. 
Also visually you will be able to understand what features will be on the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/144427e5e55f68dd17f3eba7c372eb251dae627f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/96f053f2f1b756676b9108b4f036f617de24fa0f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/42a19fc68067275a0c36e3a89ebb3a85730a458d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/9937b2cdc6091e746fe76b764e7338fd7b0a5fe4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/04deabea9062dc99b51bc3cd45cc680328bf5ee8.gif[/img]

If you have sailed to an island and have passed several levels and have trouble making it through, you can visit another one. However, you will need to participate in naval battles before you get to another island.

Thank you very much for your attention! Until the next devlog!

notes.title: DEVLOG #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/489b731903f2210cdc3fe53ea5224660bfac7841.png[/img]

[h2][b]Greetings![/b][/h2]

[i]In this devlog we'd like to talk about a pretty big gameplay update when playing as a possessed.
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/434dd0194908937ea9221e5d05e486c8e86fa4d4.gif[/img]

[i]Old and slow attack ːsteamthumbsdownː[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/7001e0fcbf087a73e45afa82ae60dfe9f4adcd95.gif[/img]

[i]New fast and beautiful[/i] ːsteamthumbsupː

[h3] [b]We got rid of damage on touch[/b].[/h3]
The gameplay felt clunky. Since the game has the ability to move around a little when you hit it, sometimes you could accidentally bump into an opponent and take damage. Now in these sections of the game, damage will only come from enemies' weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/c0ea2c57732121550db4581d1d40cbf73840fa41.gif[/img]

This may be in contrast to the gameplay for the human-shaped character, where the damage on touch is left unchanged, but in the initial stages of the game there will be a story tutorial. There, these differences will be explained story-wise and shown through gameplay.

[h3]We also increased the [b]attack speed[/b] of the hero and introduced [b]finishing moves[/b].[/h3]

They will need to be unlocked in the store for [b]Dark Essence[/b] currency. 

[h3] A [b]rating system[/b] has also been added [/h3]
If the player will alternate finishing blows with special abilities - the rating will increase. Depending on your rating, you will receive a different amount of Dark Essence when killing enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/2079b90a48c7102201b1b80e41ea12dd177fd32c.gif[/img]

That's all for now. Thank you so much for staying with us! See you around!

notes.title: DevLog #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/489b731903f2210cdc3fe53ea5224660bfac7841.png[/img]

[h1]Hello, everyone! [/h1]
This is the second devlog in which I want to talk about mistakes. 
It's not uncommon for players to die in the same place several times. Especially frustrating when you can not constantly save, and the nearest checkpoint is very far away. And, you have to run through the easy parts of the level over and over again, only to eventually lose your life again on the difficult for the player fragment and start all over again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/cb53be6ac685d6723cf8313d71000deec282a312.gif[/img]

To solve this problem, I put magic gates at each checkpoint. They work like this: if a player dies more than once in a certain part of the level (in some situations, once is enough), he will see a blue or green glow over his character. After that, you can use the gate to teleport to that room. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/94ed5eb9e1e5a8bcfedf67a76d8262342646a8b5.gif[/img]

What does this solve ?
1. Players who aren't interested in running through the same boring sections dozens of times will be able to concentrate at once on the rooms that cause them difficulty and save time (and nerves)
2. Players who want to collect all the treasures, and will be able to do without the gate, because all the good collected between the last checkpoint and the death of the hero, lost.

Thank you all for your attention!

notes.title: DevLog #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/1ec41be3ff45208d94a8f4253ac54d26b70faa0f.png[/img]

[h2]News[/h2]

Ahoy! We decided to start sharing news about the process of creating Corsair's Madness. We'll try not to go into deep silence and will be releasing blogs once every 2 weeks or once a month. 

[h2]To business[/h2]

And the first thing we'd like to talk about is the map and level structure.

In Corsair's Madness there will be several groups of islands available for playthrough. On each of them there will be several points to visit - the settlement of the natives, levels for the corsair in human form, levels for the possessed corsair and levels with an endurance test. In between these levels there will be the ability to travel by boat, which is implemented as a shoot'em up game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/9cc6f8e39e916c092f95cdee32d45beebe809338.gif[/img]
This is one of the early images of the whole map ːsteamfacepalmː. Of course, while the game was in development, the map grew, and we had to divide it into separate groups of islands.

It was decided to take the Megaman games as the basis, where you can choose any level to visit from the very beginning. In Corsair's Madness you will be free to travel through groups of islands in any order. Each of them will differ in their puzzles, the items used, and their special mechanics.

That's all for now. In parallel with the map, the main story is in development. Hopefully next time we will be able to share details of the story, dialogues and characters inhabiting the mysterious archipelago.

Thank you!
